t: What Miniature Painting Is All About
title: What Miniature Painting Is All About
description: Miniature painters bring tiny gaming models and display pieces to life with acrylic paints — from tabletop-ready armies to competition showpieces. It's patience, color theory, and brush control at 28mm scale. Home hobby desks, game stores, clubs, and competitions. Wargamers, RPG players, and pure artists all paint. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.
